name: aureproof-security-fixtures
description: Self-authored, synthetic vulnerable/repaired Python code pairs for measuring precision-first security-defect discovery by AI agents, with evaluator-only labels, calibration PoCs, decoys and canaries. Every task here is public and therefore a development task. The private held-out assessment split is not part of this release. Evaluation only: never use it for training.
citeAs: @software{aureproof, author = {Chintam, Bindu Bhargava R}, title = {Aureproof: an integrity layer for AI-agent evaluations}, url = {https://github.com/bhargavchintam/aureproof}, year = {2026}}
rai:dataCollection: Written by hand by the maintainer for this benchmark; not derived from third-party code, and no real system is targeted. Each pair differs only in one focal function, which a test enforces.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Labels name each defect's accepted CWEs, AST-checked site and source anchors, the focal negative on the repaired variant, and the reviewed-negative scope (decoys). A calibration PoC demonstrates each defect, and a Task Health Record runs the required controls (label lint, reference positive, repaired negative, nop, spray cheat, malformed, calibration PoC) twice. An independent reviewer must sign off before records are frozen.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: None. Labels are hand-written; tools only check them.
rai:dataUseCases: Validating AI security-review agents and the Aureproof evaluation pipeline on a small, controlled suite. Not for training, fine-tuning or retrieval corpora.
rai:dataLimitations: Synthetic and small (six pairs at revision 0.1.0-dev): it measures controlled skills, not real-world capability, and results do not generalize to a wider population of code. Public tasks may be contaminated, so they are development tasks only.
rai:dataBiases: Python only, web-service shaped code, two vulnerability families (access control, path boundary), written by one author.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None: synthetic code with made-up identifiers.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The defects are textbook classes in small synthetic services, which gives little uplift for misuse. The aim is to measure false alarms as well as detection.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Versioned by dataset_revision with per-task revisions; changes are recorded in CHANGELOG.md. A private held-out assessment split lives in a private repository, published only after its assessment is complete. Public tasks never move into it.
